name: elagoht/indexnow
description: A collage plugin that tells search engines which URLs changed, through the IndexNow protocol: Bing, Yandex, Seznam, Naver and the others that share what one of them is told.
setup: Set `"key"` (8 to 128 letters, digits and dashes, such as `openssl rand -hex 16` makes) in this plugin's section of `plugins-config.json`, and the site's origin: `BASE_URL` in a project `collage new` made (it becomes `Config.BaseURL`), or an origin resolver such as `elagoht/tenant`. Without either the application does not start.

config.description: A collage plugin that tells search engines which URLs changed, through the IndexNow protocol: Bing, Yandex, Seznam, Naver and the others that share what one of them is told.

backoff.description: Backoff is how long the first retry waits, doubled for each one after it, unless the endpoint says otherwise with Retry-After: "2s". Default two seconds.

batchSize.description: BatchSize caps how many URLs one request carries. Default and at most MaxBatch; negative is an error.

endpoint.description: Endpoint is where the URLs are posted. Default IndexNow's shared endpoint, "https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow", which passes what it is told on to every participating search engine; a search engine's own, "https://www.bing.com/indexnow", works the same.

inDevelopment.description: InDevelopment sends from a development server too, which is otherwise silent: what changes on a laptop is not news to a search engine.

key.description: Key proves the site is yours: 8 to 128 letters, digits and dashes, served at /<key>.txt. Required. Any value works; keep it the same across deployments.

retries.description: Retries is how many more times a request is tried when the endpoint answers 429 or 5xx, or cannot be reached. Default 3; negative is an error.

skip.description: Skip are request path prefixes never sent: "/api", "/search". Each begins with "/", and covers the path itself and everything under it, with or without a trailing "/".

window.description: Window is how long URLs are collected after the first one before they are sent together: "10s", "1m". Default ten seconds.
